review_notes: Issue #2025 reproduces copy and pickle failures for Undefined objects, and merged PR #2026 preserves slot metadata while making dunder protocol probing raise AttributeError.
Retain src/jinja2/runtime.py; the decisive slot restoration is module-level, so no single pre-fix symbol is assigned. Tests and changelog are excluded.
Issue #14050 reproduces LaTeXTranslator aborting on the standard acronym role, and merged PR #14202 adds the missing LaTeX visitor behavior.
Retain sphinx/writers/latex.py; the visitor is newly introduced by the fix and therefore has no pre-fix symbol target. Authors and changelog files are excluded.
Issue #1632 reproduces URL pickling failures on Python 3.15, and merged PR #1687 returns a raw tuple from URL.__getstate__ without changing legacy __setstate__ compatibility.
Retain yarl/_url.py::URL.__getstate__; tests and changelog are excluded.
Issue #3105 shows virtualenv help ignoring terminal width, and merged PR #3110 replaces the hard-coded width with shutil.get_terminal_size().columns.
Retain src/virtualenv/config/cli/parser.py::HelpFormatter.__init__; tests and changelog are excluded.
Issue #7432 reproduces redirected uploads failing for file wrappers that expose __iter__ through __getattr__, and merged PR #7433 restores delegated-iterator stream detection.
Retain src/requests/models.py::PreparedRequest.prepare_body; tests are excluded.
Issue #655 asks for a controllable isolated build-environment location, and merged PR #1083 adds env_dir propagation through the API and CLI plus path-aware lifecycle handling.
Retain src/build/__main__.py::build_package and src/build/env.py::DefaultIsolatedEnv; src/build/_exceptions.py is docstring-only, while docs, changelog, and tests are excluded.
Issue #1305 reports strict-bytes type failures for bytearray and memoryview inputs, and merged PR #1315 broadens the receive path and normalizes frame-buffer input through memoryview.
Retain H2Connection.receive_data and FrameBuffer.add_data in the two existing production files; the added type-only protocol, tests, docs, changelog, and project metadata are excluded.
Issue #6199 reports a process-global mutex serializing multithreaded embedders, and merged PR #6200 adds an atomic dirty fast path in ReferencePool.
Narrow the automatic list to src/internal/state.rs; nox, benchmark, workflow, and news files are auxiliary, and Rust symbol ground truth remains file-only.
Issue #27637 requests the same rule-code hyperlinks in statistics output as normal check output, and merged PR #27646 reuses the diagnostic URL and stylesheet hyperlink helper.
All three Rust production files are required for printing, helper export, and stylesheet behavior; tests are excluded and Rust symbols remain file-only.
Issue #3975 reproduces parallel runs closing reused file descriptors, and merged PR #3976 prevents the child pty descriptor from being closed twice.
Retain src/tox/execute/local_sub_process/__init__.py::LocalSubProcessExecuteInstance.get_stream_file_no; tests and changelog are excluded.
